svg.aria-label: The test rig: a load generator with four vCPUs and eight gigabytes of RAM on one side, the twelve dollar target with one vCPU and two gigabytes on the other, less than a millisecond of network between them. The generator's own CPU peaked at 37 per cent while the target reached 80 per cent at its ceiling. A cost line shows 4.5 hours at 13 cents an hour came to 60 cents. The caption explains that reporting the generator's own utilisation is what makes the result admissible, because a generator running near its own limit measures itself, and that failure looks exactly like the target slowing down.
svg.text: MEASURE THE INSTRUMENT, NOT JUST THE SUBJECT
